name: title/titlecard-calm
title: Titlecard calm
desc_vi: Dòng nhãn nhỏ kiểu mono trồi lên trước, tiêu đề lớn theo sau, cả khối trôi lên rất nhẹ trong lúc giữ rồi mờ ra với một nhịp nhích lên.
params_vi: headline: tiêu đề lớn · kicker: nhãn nhỏ phía trên (tự viết hoa) · duration: độ dài gốc 4 s (quyết định thời gian giữ và lúc mờ ra) · bg, fg, muted: màu (bg trong suốt = lấy nền phim)
notes: Layout, sizes and envelope as in the source (lockup 78 cqw wide with a 6 cqh gap; kicker 3.2 cqmin / weight 600 / tracking 0.18em; headline 17 cqmin / weight 600 / line-height 0.94 / tracking -0.055em, balanced wrap; kicker 0.5 s power2.out from 2.2 cqh, headline 0.72 s power3.out from 3.2 cqh at 0.28 s, hold drift to -0.65 cqh with sine.inOut over the whole hold, exit 0.55 s power2.in to -2.1 cqh + opacity 0; IN / OUT shrink together when the duration is below 1.75 s). cqw / cqh / cqmin are taken from the target box. The source's mount duration is the param `duration` (authored 4 s) because the hold and the exit depend on it. Tweens are written as fromTo with explicit start values (the source set the lockup first and used to for the drift / exit). The headline uses the film's font (source: Helvetica Neue / Helvetica / Arial theme token). The kicker is the source's monospace face: the system monospace stack (Consolas / Cascadia Mono / Menlo), no font file ships; it is upper-cased in code instead of text-transform. The mounted-card frame of the source demo (rounded card with border and shadow, 78 % x 62 %) is not part of the primitive. Defaults are Vietnamese (source: Less, but better / DESIGN PRINCIPLE). 05/10/2026: monospace text uses the kit's Roboto Mono ("RMono", Vietnamese complete, the same on every machine) before the system stack.
